name: CheXGenBench
intro: CheXGenBench是一个统一的评估框架，旨在全面评估合成胸部X光图像的保真度、隐私性和下游实用性，通过20多种定量指标标准化评估文本到图像生成模型。
org: The University of Edinburgh, Samsung AI Center
build_method: 统一 MIMIC-CXR 的 237,388 训练/5,034 测试划分与 LLaVA-Rad 增强提示；对 9 个基础架构微调 20 轮，RadEdit 与 LLM-CXR 开箱评测；按保真度、隐私和下游效用三轴评估
metric: RadDino FID/KID, BioViL-T, PRDC, Siamese re-ID, Accuracy/AUROC, DICE, BLEU, ROUGE-L, F1-RadGraph, GREENScore, RaTEScore
eval_feature: 评估合成胸部X光图像的保真度, 隐私性和下游实用性
scale: 237,388 个训练样本, 5,034 个留出测试样本, 11 个 T2I 系统（9 个微调 + 2 个开箱评测）
build_method_en: Use fixed MIMIC-CXR splits with 237,388 training and 5,034 test samples plus enhanced LLaVA-Rad prompts; fine-tune 9 foundation architectures for 20 epochs while evaluating RadEdit and LLM-CXR out-of-the-box; assess fidelity, privacy, and downstream utility
eval_feature_en: evaluate fidelity, privacy, and downstream utility of synthetic chest X-ray images
intro_en: CheXGenBench is a unified evaluation framework designed to comprehensively assess the fidelity, privacy, and downstream utility of synthetic chest X-ray images, standardizing the evaluation of text-to-image generation models through over 20 quantitative metrics.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with the current arXiv:2505.10496v4 / TMLR 2026 paper, especially §§2.1–2.4 and §3. Official repository snapshot cc7e91e was inspected, but the paper remains primary where the repository lags: the snapshot exposes classification utilities and generated-image evaluation while not exposing the v4 segmentation implementation. The evaluated systems split into 9 fine-tuned foundation architectures plus RadEdit and LLM-CXR evaluated out-of-the-box. They use enhanced LLaVA-Rad captions, a fixed 237,388-sample training split, and a 5,034-sample held-out test split. Fine-tuning runs for 20 epochs, with full fine-tuning below 1B parameters and LoRA rank 32 on Q/K/V layers above 1B. Fidelity covers RadDino FID/KID and PRDC, BioViL-T alignment, and pathology-conditional analysis. Privacy covers pixel distance, RadDino latent distance, and Siamese re-identification statistics. Utility covers ResNet-50 classification on 20K real plus 20K synthetic samples, clavicle segmentation with 3,000 real plus 3,000 synthetic pairs and DICE, and LLaVA-Rad report generation from 50K real plus 20K synthetic samples with BLEU, ROUGE-L, F1-RadGraph, GREENScore, and RaTEScore.
